canonical_project: DTS trans-Saharan fiber route - Kanem zone
owner: DTS (Dorsale Transsaharienne a fibre optique) project - Ministry of Telecommunications; EU-funded (EUR 29m)
notes: The DTS project coordinator (Ahmat Badawi Hamit) states the project covers the Kanem, Lac and Hadjer-Lamis provinces (technical sites and fiber installation zones, works ongoing since 2023).
